overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that `end.replace(year=end.year - 5)` would always produce a valid date, overlooking that when `end` is February 29 of a leap year, subtracting 5 years lands on a non-leap year where February 29 does not exist.
why_it_breaks: When `end` is February 29 of a leap year (e.g., 2024), calling `.replace(year=2019)` attempts to create February 29, 2019, which does not exist because 2019 is not a leap year. Python raises `ValueError: day is out of range for month`. The agent did not account for calendar validity when shifting the year backward by a fixed amount.
